placeholder.dashboardDescription: App usage stats, distribution, hourly charts and calendar heatmap will be shown here.
placeholder.calendarDescription: Monthly usage records with year navigation and Chinese weekdays.
placeholder.networkDescription: Real-time speed curves and historical statistics will be shown here.
placeholder.settingsDescription: Tracking switches, auto-refresh, fonts, log path and uninstall entry.

dashboard.aggregateHint: Aggregate cards combine several cards into one: enabling one automatically hides its member cards (for example, Hardware aggregate and Temperature aggregate are mutually exclusive).
dashboard.editDescription: Drag tiles to reorder, drag the corner handle to resize, click the eye to hide a card.
dashboard.resizeHandle: Resize: drag left/right for width, up/down for height
dashboard.resizeHint: Drag a tile to reorder · drag the bottom-right handle to resize (drag sideways for width, up/down for height)
dashboard.emptyGrid: All cards are hidden — restore them below

cardsDesc.appUsage: Bar chart and details by app

dashboard.empty: No usage data yet — it will be recorded automatically as you use apps.

usage.title: App usage
usage.noDetail: No more details for this app.

network.liveZoomHint: Scroll wheel zooms the Y-axis · double-click to reset
network.appTrafficEmpty: No app network activity yet — tracks apps with TCP connections
network.bytesHint: Byte-level traffic requires administrator rights (Windows limitation); showing TCP connection counts instead.
network.attrEmpty: No app traffic records in this period yet (Windows official accounting, usually up to ~1 hour behind)
network.attrUnavailable: Per-app traffic data is unavailable right now (no network connection or unsupported system).
network.attrHint: Source: Windows data usage (no admin) · {{since}} ~ {{until}} · not real-time, ~hourly updates

hardware.title: Hardware monitor
hardware.description: Real-time CPU usage, memory usage, CPU/GPU temperature and disk health monitoring (temperature data is more complete with administrator rights).
hardware.liveHint: Live refresh interval: {{seconds}}s (adjustable in Settings → General → Live data refresh interval)
hardware.avgTempHint: Average = mean of all core temperatures ({{cores}} cores)
hardware.gpuNotFound: No NVIDIA GPU detected (GPU temperature only supports NVIDIA)
hardware.diskTempHint: Disk temperature comes from the Windows storage interface: most NVMe SSDs only report values with administrator rights; show — when unavailable.
hardware.diskHealthHint: Health status is usually readable without admin; reliability data (temperature, wear, power-on hours, read/write errors) is more complete with administrator rights.
hardware.driverConfirmDescription: The kernel driver writes to the system core and requires administrator rights; security software (e.g. 360) may block it. If THRM already installed it, Digitrace will reuse it without reinstalling.

monitor.autoTrackDescription: Start tracking app usage automatically on launch.
monitor.pollIntervalDescription: How often the background monitor samples.
monitor.idleThresholdDescription: No activity for this long counts as idle.

refresh.intervalDescription: How often dashboard and title bar live data refresh.
refresh.liveIntervalDescription: How often hardware and network live curves refresh (1s is smoother but uses a bit more resources).
refresh.liveWindowDescription: How long second-level network samples are kept in the backend memory buffer (cleared on restart; longer periods come from the minute-level history).

timezone.title: Date timezone
timezone.description: Day boundaries for Today / This week / This month and history windows.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Switch between light, dark, or follow the system.

blur.title: Window Material
blur.description: Choose the window backdrop. Applies after restart.
blur.manualRestartNotice: Window material saved. It takes effect after restarting the app
blur.restartDescription: The new material takes effect after restarting the app. Restart now?

font.title: Interface font
font.description: Choose the UI font. Applies immediately.

zoom.title: UI zoom
zoom.description: Scale the whole UI (fonts, cards, charts together); the percentage pops up at the top while dragging.

language.title: Language
language.description: Switch interface language instantly; your choice is remembered.

startup.autoStartDescription: Start in the background (tray) automatically after logging into Windows.
startup.elevatedDescription: Use a Windows scheduled task with highest privileges so hardware data (e.g. CPU temperature) is available right after login; one UAC confirmation is required when enabling.
startup.elevatedEnabled: Elevated auto-start enabled (takes effect next login)
startup.elevatedFailed: Failed to enable elevated auto-start (UAC may have been cancelled)
startup.minimizeToTrayDescription: Hide to tray when closing; the process keeps running.
startup.launchShowWindowDescription: Show the main window on launch; turn off to stay in the tray. Auto-start at logon always stays silently in the tray; restart, update or reinstall always opens the main window.

tray.title: Tray display
tray.hint: Live data shows in the hover tooltip (version on the first line); the right-click menu keeps only actions, with the version at the end.

hardware.statusRunning: Installed v{{version}} · Running (shared with other apps)
hardware.driverRisk: Risk & trade-off: CPU temperature requires reading CPU registers (MSR), which Windows only allows with administrator rights plus a kernel driver. Please confirm you understand: the driver writes to the system core, requires admin rights, and may be blocked by security software (e.g. 360). Not installing only means no CPU temperature; everything else keeps working. If THRM or other apps already installed it, Digitrace reuses it without reinstalling.
hardware.tempDescription: GPU: no admin needed (NVML). Disk: Windows storage interface, best effort, usually needs admin. CPU: needs the PawnIO kernel driver and running Digitrace as administrator; after one admin restart it can read, and you can run normally afterwards.
hardware.installDescription: This launches the official PawnIO installer (needs administrator rights). The system may show security prompts or 360 may block it; please allow it. After installation, return here and the status will change to Running.
hardware.uninstallDescription: CPU temperature will be unavailable after uninstall. Note: other apps such as THRM may be using this driver; please confirm before uninstalling.

logs.dataLocationDescription: Usage, network and config data are stored here (local only, never uploaded)

data.clearDescription: Delete all locally saved usage and monitoring records.
data.confirmDescription: This cannot be undone. All usage, calendar and network records will be deleted.
data.exportDescription: Decrypts diary entries and window titles into a JSON file (plaintext — keep it safe; useful before reinstalling Windows).

update.autoCheckDescription: At most once per day, at no fixed time: ~6s after launch, then polling every 6 hours, deduplicated by calendar day.
update.silentUpdateDescription: Download updates in the background, replace silently on exit and restart to tray — no prompts, no notifications.
update.checkTimeDescription: Check for updates daily at this hour; "Unfixed" checks ~6s after launch and then every 6 hours (deduplicated by calendar day).
update.manifestUrlDescription: JSON format: { version, url, sha256, notes }. Must be HTTPS; downloads are verified against the SHA-256 hash.
update.githubRepoDescription: Check the latest release of a public GitHub repository directly (like THRM). Takes priority over the manifest URL. Format: owner/repo.
update.hint: Updates are hash-verified and refused if verification fails; the old process exits before being replaced.
update.statusNoUrl: No update source configured — no network checks are made.
update.statusAutoOn: Automatic checks enabled (at most one network request per day).
update.statusAutoOff: Automatic checks off — the app only goes online when you click "Check for updates".

about.privacyDescription: All data stays on this device at %APPDATA%\TimeTrace. Nothing is uploaded.

takeover.title: New version v{{version}} detected
takeover.description: Quit the current version and launch the new one?
takeover.elevatedHint: The new version will start as administrator. Click "Switch now" and confirm the system security prompt.
takeover.showWindow: Open the main window after switching

health.enableDescription: Get a Windows notification to stand up and move after using the PC continuously for a set time.
health.breakThreshold: Away time that counts as a break (resets the timer)
health.hint: Health reminders run entirely on this PC: continuous usage is detected from keyboard/mouse activity, and no data is uploaded.
